old_description: 三花汽零是全球领先的汽车领域冷热转换和温度控制相关产品和技术提供商。我们专注于新能源汽车热管理，以热泵系统、控制阀组件、换热技术和变频器控制为核心，实现了汽车热管理核心部件的全面覆盖。公司现有产品包括热力膨胀阀、单向阀、电子膨胀阀、冷媒电磁阀、电子水阀等阀类产品；电子水泵、电子油泵等泵类产品；换热器、电池冷板、贮液器、气液分离器等各系列产品。可满足新能源汽车的空调热管理、动力电池热管理、电机热管理等多种场景需求。公司已成为新能源汽车热管理领域的领军企业，自主研发的电子膨胀阀产品在2017年荣获国际创新大奖——PACE奖，是中国首家获此殊荣的民营企业。公司持续深耕汽车热管理零部件的创新研发，积极布局新能源汽车领域所需的各种热管理集成组件，为全球客户提供可提高车辆经济性、增加续航里程的产品解决方案。
about:
Sanhua Automotive USA, INC is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, serving as the North American arm of a global thermal-management specialist founded in 2004. The parent company, Zhejiang Sanhua Automotive Parts Co., Ltd., is a subsidiary of the publicly listed Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls (stock code 002050) and began as a developer of automotive thermal valves in Hangzhou, China. The U.S. entity was established to support the company's expanding North American R&D center and customer base.

The company designs and manufactures a broad range of thermal-management components for new-energy vehicles, including electronic expansion valves, solenoid valves, electronic water and oil pumps, heat exchangers, battery cold plates, liquid receivers, and gas-liquid separators. Its core technologies span heat-pump systems, control-valve assemblies, heat-exchange engineering, and variable-frequency control. Globally, the organization employs over 9,600 people, with more than 1,000 dedicated to research and development across four technical centers in China, North America, and Europe, and operates five production bases in China, Mexico, Europe, and India.

Sanhua supplies major automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the electric-vehicle and traditional automotive sectors. Its customer roster includes Huawei, Tesla, Changan, Great Wall, BYD, Geely, SAIC, and European brands such as Volkswagen and Renault, as evidenced by numerous supplier awards from these companies. The components serve cabin climate control, battery thermal management, and electric-motor cooling applications.

The company differentiates itself through its early focus on electronic expansion valves, which earned the 2017 Automotive News PACE Award — the first such honor for a Chinese private enterprise. It emphasizes integrated thermal-management solutions that improve vehicle efficiency and extend driving range, backed by national-level engineering centers, comprehensive testing capabilities, and a portfolio of over 740 patents.
